successionCap160.statute: Law of Succession Act (Cap 160), Laws of Kenya

sections.scenario: Monogamous intestate leaving surviving spouse and children
sections.rule: Surviving spouse receives personal and household effects absolutely plus a life interest in the whole net residue; children share the remainder equally upon termination of life interest (death or remarriage of widow).

sections.scenario: Intestate leaving children only (no surviving spouse)
sections.rule: Net intestate estate is divided equally among all surviving children (sons and daughters equally, regardless of marital status).

sections.scenario: Intestate leaving no surviving spouse or children
sections.rule: Devolves in strict statutory priority: (1) Father, (2) Mother, (3) Brothers and sisters (and children of deceased siblings), (4) Half-brothers/sisters, (5) Relatives up to 6th degree of consanguinity, (6) Consolidated Fund (Bona Vacantia).

Personal effects and net residue are divided among the houses according to the number of children in each house, adding any surviving wife as an additional unit to the number of children in her house.

article49Rights.statute: Constitution of Kenya (2010) — Article 49 (Rights of Arrested Persons)

rules.twentyFourHourRule: Article 49(1)(f): Must be brought before a court as soon as reasonably possible, and not later than 24 hours after arrest (or end of the next court day if the 24 hours ends outside ordinary court hours).
rules.bailAndBondRule: Article 49(1)(h): Right to be released on bond or bail on reasonable conditions pending a charge or trial, unless there are compelling reasons not to be released.
rules.pettyOffenceNoRemandRule: Article 49(2): A person shall not be remanded in custody for an offence punishable by a fine only or by imprisonment for not more than 6 months.

scripts.title: Ask Reason for Arrest & Officer Identification
scripts.english: Officer, under Article 49(1)(a) of the Constitution, please tell me clearly why I am being arrested, your name, service number, and which police station we are going to.
scripts.swahili: Afisa, kulingana na Kifungu cha 49(1)(a) cha Katiba, tafadhali nieleze wazi sababu ya kunikamata, jina lako, nambari yako ya kazi, na kituo cha polisi tunachoelekea.

scripts.title: Request to Contact Family or Advocate
scripts.english: Under Article 49(1)(c), I have the right to communicate with an advocate and a family member. Please allow me to make a phone call and give me the OB number.
scripts.swahili: Chini ya Kifungu cha 49(1)(c), nina haki ya kuwasiliana na wakili na mtu wa familia. Tafadhali niruhusu kupiga simu na unipe nambari ya OB.

scripts.title: Assert Right to Remain Silent
scripts.english: Under Article 49(1)(b) and (d), I choose to remain silent and will not sign any statement or confession without my advocate present.
scripts.swahili: Chini ya Kifungu cha 49(1)(b) na (d), nachagua kukaa kimya na sitatia sahihi taarifa yoyote bila wakili wangu kuwepo.

scripts.title: Request Police Cash Bail & 24-Hour Compliance
scripts.english: Under Article 49(1)(f), (h) and 49(2), I request release on reasonable police cash bail with an official receipt, or arraignment in court within 24 hours.
scripts.swahili: Chini ya Kifungu cha 49(1)(f), (h) na 49(2), naomba kuachiliwa kwa dhamana ya polisi (cash bail) na risiti rasmi, au kufikishwa mahakamani ndani ya saa 24.
